data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis, HIGH): once wired into SKILL.md Step 1, resolve-feature-flag-approval.sh runs on EVERY future implementation-plan invocation for EVERY story. It MUST degrade to safe-default 'prohibited' + exit 0 (NEVER non-zero, which would HALT Step 1 planning for all stories) on: (a) no parent_id / null parent (top-level/orphan story); (b) parent ticket show fails or returns sparse output (jira-* mirror sync lag); (c) ticket CLI unavailable; (d) neither story nor parent tagged. Each emits a non-empty distinct reason. Parse parent_id from the ticket show JSON 'parent_id' field. Verify: grep -qiE 'exit 0|return 0' plugins/dso/scripts/implementation-plan/resolve-feature-flag-approval.sh && grep -qiE 'parent_id' plugins/dso/scripts/implementation-plan/resolve-feature-flag-approval.sh
